prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A whimsical, animated scene set in a brightly lit supermarket dairy aisle. The central focus is a large, anthropomorphic milk carton with expressive cartoon features—big blue eyes, raised eyebrows, and a small, slightly worried mouth. The carton has thin, white, flexible arms and hands, one of which is raised in a gesture of mild concern or surprise. The carton is predominantly white with light blue accents, featuring Greek text and a simple logo. It is being held gently by a person in a red sweater, visible only from the back and side, with their face mostly out of frame, drawing attention to the interaction. The background is softly blurred, filled with rows of similar dairy products, creating a sense of depth and emphasizing the main subject. The color palette is cool and clean, dominated by whites and blues, with the red sweater providing a striking contrast. The lighting is even and natural, evoking a cheerful, commercial-like atmosphere. The overall style blends live-action with high-quality 3D animation, capturing a playful, family-friendly mood with a touch of humor and charm.
